runTimeout.description: Maximum runtime (seconds) of an episode (not necessarily DONE).

savePrompt.description: If disabled, skip logging LLM prompts in the replay file.

seed.description: Integer used to select a starting position (when useOpenings is true) and to seed chance-node sampling so episodes are reproducible.

strictMode.description: If true, agents must return only {'submission': int} (no extra fields like 'thoughts'), and per-agent TIMEOUT/ERROR/INVALID counts as a loss for the offending agent only — other agents are marked DONE with a winning reward. legalActions.description: List of OpenSpiel legal action integers. Only included if includeLegalActions is true.
